findings.issue: The seven `calc` chains (`hYL`, `hYd`, `hYe`, `h_cub'`, `h_factor`, and the two `hYu`/`hYd2` pairs) re-derive by hand what `linear_combination` / `linarith` provide in one line each; `hYd` even round-trips through the vacuous step `_ = a.Yd := by ring`.

summary: The module builds a second, self-contained Standard Model anomaly-cancellation API (assignments record plus linear and cubic functionals) without importing anything from Physlib, although the roadmap's own dependency section names Physlib's SM AnomalyCancellation and Representations modules as the upstream for exactly this material. The uniqueness proof also re-derives linear solving by hand instead of using Mathlib's `linear_combination`.
